inferred_requirements.title: Atomic Financial Ledger Transaction
inferred_requirements.description: Execute financial ledger entries inside an atomic transaction boundary such that either all constituent entries are committed or the entire transaction is rolled back.
inferred_requirements.justification: Directly requested in the prompt: 'Implement an atomic financial ledger transaction'.

inferred_requirements.title: Debit and Credit Balance Invariance
inferred_requirements.description: Enforce that the sum of all debits equals the sum of all credits within every ledger transaction to maintain structural double-entry balance invariance.
inferred_requirements.justification: Directly requested in the prompt: 'debit/credit balance invariance'.

inferred_requirements.title: Idempotency Check
inferred_requirements.description: Perform an idempotency check using a unique request identifier to ensure duplicate transaction requests are detected and prevented from executing multiple times.
inferred_requirements.justification: Directly requested in the prompt: 'idempotency check'.

inferred_requirements.title: Serializable Isolation Level for Concurrency Control
inferred_requirements.description: Execute ledger transactions under SERIALIZABLE isolation or equivalent optimistic concurrency control mechanisms with version checking.
inferred_requirements.justification: Why 1: Concurrent transactions modifying the same accounts can cause race conditions and lost updates. Why 2: Strict isolation or optimistic version locking prevents concurrent interference during balance calculation and posting. Why 3: Mandatory invariant that account balances must never reflect intermediate or uncommitted states.

inferred_requirements.title: Idempotency Key Storage and TTL Provider
inferred_requirements.description: The specific storage mechanism, backing data store (e.g., Redis, PostgreSQL), and time-to-live (TTL) configuration for idempotency keys are unstated.
inferred_requirements.justification: No specific technology or retention window was provided in the prompt for storing idempotency keys.

inferred_requirements.title: Ledger Account Data Schema and Identifier Standard
inferred_requirements.description: The specific schema layout, database engine, and identifier format (e.g., UUIDv4, ULID, account number formatting standard) for accounts and transactions are unstated.
inferred_requirements.justification: The prompt does not define the underlying database platform, schema design, or identifier specifications.
